title: Fix Agent Memory & Enforce Small-Step Workflow
description: Agents are crashing and losing memory. Update AGENTS.md to enforce small-step workflow, assess current memory system state, fix runtime errors and persistence issues, verify with tests.

title: Fix memory runtime errors based on assessment
description: Based on the assessment report (subtask 1), fix any runtime errors found in the memory system. This includes connection leaks, async issues, missing error handling, incorrect SQL, RLS setup failures, and any exceptions that cause agents to crash. Make MINIMAL changes. One fix at a time. Check tests after each change. Files to modify depend on assessment findings, likely within src/pillywiggins/memory/.

title: Fix memory persistence / state-loss based on assessment
description: Based on the assessment report (subtask 1), fix any persistence or state-loss issues. This includes: data not being written to PostgreSQL, cache not being saved to Redis, embeddings not being stored, RLS policies preventing correct reads, connections not being committed, or transactions being rolled back incorrectly. Make MINIMAL changes. One fix at a time. Verify persistence with tests. Files to modify depend on assessment findings, likely within src/pillywiggins/memory/.

title: Verify all fixes with tests and end-to-end validation
description: Run the full test suite for the memory and agent modules. Ensure: (1) test_private_memory.py passes, (2) test_council.py passes, (3) test_cache.py passes, (4) test_embeddings.py passes, (5) test_agents.py passes, (6) test_brain.py passes, (7) test_rls_isolation.py passes. If any fail, report the exact error and do NOT mark this task complete until they pass. Also run a quick smoke test if available.

title: Update AGENTS.md to enforce small-step workflow
description: Update the AGENTS.md file at the project root to add a mandatory 'Small-Step Workflow' section. It must state that agents MUST only do one small step at a time, verify it works (tests pass, no errors), and ONLY THEN move to the next step. This is essential and must never be forgotten. Add it near the top, right after Quickstart or in a dedicated 'Workflow Rules' section. Also add a Gotcha about it.

title: Assess current memory system state
description: Read and assess the current state of the memory system and agent runtime. Files to read: src/pillywiggins/memory/private.py, src/pillywiggins/memory/council.py, src/pillywiggins/memory/store.py, src/pillywiggins/memory/cache.py, src/pillywiggins/memory/embeddings.py, src/pillywiggins/agents/deps.py, src/pillywiggins/agents/base.py, src/pillywiggins/agents/brain.py. Look for: (1) obvious bugs, (2) missing error handling, (3) incorrect connection handling, (4) state loss patterns, (5) RLS setup issues, (6) asyncio.Lock misuse. Return a concise but thorough report with specific line numbers and issues. Also check existing tests (test_private_memory.py, test_council.py, test_cache.py, test_embeddings.py, test_agents.py, test_brain.py) to see which pass/fail.

title: Fix embeddings.py IndexError and session reuse
description:
Fix two issues in embeddings.py:
1. Guard against empty embeddings list before indexing (line 228) to prevent IndexError
2. Reuse a single aiohttp.ClientSession instead of creating new one per request (lines 99-125)
Files: src/pillywiggins/memory/embeddings.py, tests/test_embeddings.py

title: Fix council.py RLS and exception handling
description:
Fix two critical runtime issues in council.py:
1. Add _ensure_agent_id(conn) call before all DB operations to enforce RLS
2. Wrap write_entry DB block in try/except to return graceful error instead of crashing agent
Files: src/pillywiggins/memory/council.py, tests/test_council.py, tests/test_rls_isolation.py

title: Fix brain.py os.environ mutation and config default
description:
Fix two high-priority issues:
1. brain.py lines 708-719: stop mutating global os.environ; pass OpenAI base URL and API key to PydanticAI explicitly
2. config.py: change default embedding_model from "auto" to a valid model like "nomic-embed-text" so it resolves correctly
Files: src/pillywiggins/agents/brain.py, src/pillywiggins/config.py, tests/test_brain.py, tests/test_embeddings.py

title: Fix base.py critical runtime issues
description:
Fix two critical runtime issues in base.py:
1. _on_nats_message line 211: filter tags through TAG_WHITELIST before passing to CouncilMemory.write_entry, or handle the return value so insights aren't silently discarded
2. start() lines 223-272: connect self._private_memory if it exists and is not already connected
Files: src/pillywiggins/agents/base.py, tests/test_agents.py

title: Fix base.py persistence and leak issues
description:
Fix two persistence/resource-leak issues in base.py:
1. load_history lines 173-182: assign store-loaded history to _conversation_histories[conversation_key] instead of _message_history
2. shutdown() lines 274-293: close self._private_memory, self._store, and self._cache
Files: src/pillywiggins/agents/base.py, tests/test_agents.py, tests/test_brain.py
